title: chaenorhinum origanifolium var. mutelii
intro: Chaenorhinum origanifolium var. mutelii, commonly known as the alpine toadflax, is a plant species in the family Scrophulariaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Chaenorhinum origanifolium var. mutelii include its antioxidant and spasmolytic properties, making it useful for treating conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids and phenylethanoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
